record: ANIMATION PROTOTYPE V1 — PixelLab generation provenance
mode: v3 custom (animate_character), east direction only, keep_first_frame=false

dribble.name: proto_dribble_C_noball
dribble.action_description: jogging with short choppy steps and a low crouched stance, each foot alternately reaching forward to tap the ground ahead
dribble.why: deliberately ball-free: the AUTHORITATIVE ball renders separately at the carrier's feet (engine carry_touch supplies real touch travel), so no baked ball can contradict physics

shoot.name: proto_shoot_A_10f
shoot.action_description: powerful soccer kick with the right leg: stride in, plant the left foot firmly, right leg swings far back then whips forward low and hard, striking through, long follow-through with arms out for balance, then recover to standing

rejected.dribble_A_existing_5fc20f4b: pre-existing experimental group; oversized baked ball (~0.5 m) conflicts with authoritative-ball architecture
rejected.dribble_B_e41d8020: baked ball floats at knee height, disappears in frame 7 (2 generations spent)
rejected.shoot_B_923baaf0: baked BLUE ball (palette violation) floating at waist; head drift frame 4 (2 generations spent)

generations.name: drib2_close_control
generations.action_description: very tight close-control football dribbling on the spot, tiny choppy steps, feet staying close together under the hips, small soft inside-foot taps at ground level alternating feet, knees bent, compact stance
generations.rejected_frames: 0-3: dark forearm/hip artifact could read as a held prop (character-consistency rule)

generations.name: drib2_cut_plant
generations.action_description: sharp cutting turn while running: plants one leg hard with deep knee bend, body leaning into the turn, the other foot sweeping across in front of the body at ground level, arms out for balance
generations.rejected_frames: 7: arm bulk/skin inconsistency; 0-4: rotation/walk frames held in reserve (scratchpad) for a future turn sequence

dribble2_touch_library.library_note: modular touch library = existing proto_dribble_C frames f0-f7 (contacts f1/f2=R reach, f6/f7=L reach, strides f0/f5, crossing f3/f4) + these 6 frames; metadata and deterministic selection live in match.js DRIB_LIB
